title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
description: Gemini Ultra surpasses GPT-4 on 30 of 32 benchmarks and is the first model to exceed human expert performance on MMLU. Designed as natively multimodal from pretraining (not retrofitted vision). Accepts text, images, audio, and video interleaved. Gemini 1.5 Pro extended context to 1M tokens using ring attention and linear transformers.
